Class Icons

java.lang.Object
io.mcs.taskmanager.ui.kit.Icons
public final class Icons extends Object
The app's icons, drawn from SVG paths on a square of their size: 16px line icons at a 1.5 stroke beside a label, and smaller marks inside controls. Their colour is the stylesheet's (.icon and the classes beside it), so a control's state can change it. Also the Task Manager's mark, a short checklist on a white square.
Author:
Hamza Rasool, Abdullah Khan

    • line

      public static javafx.scene.layout.Pane line(String path, double size, double strokeWidth, String... styles)
      A line icon on a square of the size, coloured by the style classes given.
      Parameters:
      path - the icon's SVG path, drawn on a square of size
      size - the square's side, in pixels
      strokeWidth - the width of its lines, in pixels
      styles - more style classes, such as "ink" for the icon of a current item
      Returns:
      the icon, a pane of exactly that size

    • mark

      public static javafx.scene.layout.Pane mark()
      The Task Manager's mark: a checklist of three rows on a white rounded square, the first two ticked off in the main action's colour, the third still open.
      Returns:
      the mark, 28 pixels square

    • markImages

      public static List<javafx.scene.image.Image> markImages()

      Returns:
